items.name: revenue_summary
items.description: HogFlix revenue snapshot from the Stripe warehouse: active subscriptions, total revenue, paying customers, avg revenue per customer. Optional source_label filter.
items.sql: SELECT (SELECT count() FROM `stripe.Demo_Stripe_Account.subscription_revenue_view` WHERE status = 'active' AND ({variables.revenue_source_label} = '' OR source_label = {variables.revenue_source_label})) AS active_subscriptions, round(sum(amount), 2) AS total_revenue, count(DISTINCT customer_id) AS paying_customers, round(sum(amount) / nullif(count(DISTINCT customer_id), 0), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_customer FROM `stripe.Demo_Stripe_Account.charge_revenue_view` WHERE {variables.revenue_source_label} = '' OR source_label = {variables.revenue_source_label}

materialization.reason: Variables not supported: Variables in OR conditions are not supported for materialization

items.name: fin_kpi_snapshot
items.description: HogFlix Finance: headline KPIs in one row. MRR, ARR, subscribers, ARPA, month-to-date movements and last month-end balances, from the fin:ledger_movement billing ledger.
items.sql:
SELECT
    round(sum(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta))) AS mrr,
    round(sum(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta)) * 12) AS arr,
    sum(toInt(properties.customers_delta)) AS customers,
    round(sum(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta)) / sum(toInt(properties.customers_delta)), 2) AS arpa,
    -- month to date
    round(sumIf(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta), timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(now()))) AS net_new_mrr_mtd,
    round(sumIf(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta), timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(now()) AND properties.movement_type = 'new')) AS new_mrr_mtd,
    round(sumIf(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta), timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(now()) AND properties.movement_type = 'expansion')) AS expansion_mrr_mtd,
    round(sumIf(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta), timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(now()) AND properties.movement_type = 'churn')) AS churn_mrr_mtd,
    sumIf(toInt(properties.customers), timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(now()) AND properties.movement_type = 'new') AS new_customers_mtd,
    sumIf(toInt(properties.customers), timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(now()) AND properties.movement_type = 'churn') AS churned_customers_mtd,
    -- last month-end balances, for deltas
    round(sumIf(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta), timestamp < toStartOfMonth(now()))) AS mrr_prev_month_end,
    sumIf(toInt(properties.customers_delta), timestamp < toStartOfMonth(now())) AS customers_prev_month_end,
    toString(max(timestamp)) AS ledger_as_of
FROM events
WHERE event = 'fin:ledger_movement'
  AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2024-09-01 00:00:00')

items.name: fin_mrr_monthly
items.description: HogFlix Finance: MRR movements per month (new, expansion, reactivation, contraction, churn), net new MRR and ending MRR as a running total of the billing ledger.
items.sql:
SELECT
    toString(month) AS month,
    new_mrr,
    expansion_mrr,
    reactivation_mrr,
    contraction_mrr,
    churn_mrr,
    net_new_mrr,
    -- ending MRR = running total of every ledger movement, opening balance included
    round(sum(total_delta) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS ending_mrr
FROM (
    SELECT
        toStartOfMonth(timestamp) AS month,
        round(sumIf(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta), properties.movement_type = 'new')) AS new_mrr,
        round(sumIf(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta), properties.movement_type = 'expansion')) AS expansion_mrr,
        round(sumIf(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta), properties.movement_type = 'reactivation')) AS reactivation_mrr,
        round(sumIf(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta), properties.movement_type = 'contraction')) AS contraction_mrr,
        round(sumIf(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta), properties.movement_type = 'churn')) AS churn_mrr,
        round(sumIf(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta), properties.movement_type != 'opening')) AS net_new_mrr,
        sum(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta)) AS total_delta
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'fin:ledger_movement'
      AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2024-09-01 00:00:00')
    GROUP BY month
)
ORDER BY month

items.name: fin_customer_churn_monthly
items.description: HogFlix Finance: subscribers per month with logo churn, revenue churn, net revenue retention and ARPA. Rates use the opening balance of each month as the denominator.
items.sql:
SELECT
    toString(m) AS month,
    ending_customers - customers_delta AS starting_customers,
    new_customers,
    reactivated_customers,
    churned_customers,
    ending_customers,
    -- all rates are measured against the opening balance of the month
    round(100 * churned_customers / nullIf(ending_customers - customers_delta, 0), 2) AS logo_churn_pct,
    round(100 * (0 - churn_mrr) / nullIf(ending_mrr - mrr_delta, 0), 2) AS revenue_churn_pct,
    round(100 * (ending_mrr - mrr_delta + expansion_mrr + contraction_mrr + churn_mrr) / nullIf(ending_mrr - mrr_delta, 0), 2) AS nrr_pct,
    round(ending_mrr / ending_customers, 2) AS arpa
FROM (
    SELECT
        m, customers_delta, mrr_delta, new_customers, reactivated_customers, churned_customers,
        churn_mrr, expansion_mrr, contraction_mrr,
        sum(customers_delta) OVER (ORDER BY m ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ending_customers,
        sum(mrr_delta) OVER (ORDER BY m ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ending_mrr
    FROM (
        SELECT
            toStartOfMonth(timestamp) AS m,
            sum(toInt(properties.customers_delta)) AS customers_delta,
            sum(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta)) AS mrr_delta,
            sumIf(toInt(properties.customers), properties.movement_type = 'new') AS new_customers,
            sumIf(toInt(properties.customers), properties.movement_type = 'reactivation') AS reactivated_customers,
            sumIf(toInt(properties.customers), properties.movement_type = 'churn') AS churned_customers,
            sumIf(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta), properties.movement_type = 'churn') AS churn_mrr,
            sumIf(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta), properties.movement_type = 'expansion') AS expansion_mrr,
            sumIf(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta), properties.movement_type = 'contraction') AS contraction_mrr
        FROM events
        WHERE event = 'fin:ledger_movement'
          AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2024-09-01 00:00:00')
        GROUP BY m
    )
)
WHERE m >= toDate('2024-11-01')
ORDER BY m

items.name: fin_mrr_by_segment
items.description: HogFlix Finance: current MRR, subscribers and month-to-date net new MRR split by a caller-chosen dimension. Pass variable fin_segment_by = plan | country | region | channel.
items.sql:
SELECT
    multiIf(
        {variables.fin_segment_by} = 'country', properties.country,
        {variables.fin_segment_by} = 'region', properties.region,
        {variables.fin_segment_by} = 'channel', properties.channel,
        properties.plan
    ) AS segment,
    round(sum(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta))) AS mrr,
    sum(toInt(properties.customers_delta)) AS customers,
    round(sum(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta)) / nullIf(sum(toInt(properties.customers_delta)), 0), 2) AS arpa,
    round(sumIf(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta), timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(now()))) AS net_new_mrr_mtd
FROM events
WHERE event = 'fin:ledger_movement'
  AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2024-09-01 00:00:00')
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY mrr DESC

items.name: fin_cohort_retention
items.description: HogFlix Finance: share of each signup cohort still subscribed after N months, for the last twelve closed months. Closed months only, so a half-finished month never flatters retention.
items.sql:
SELECT
    cohort_month,
    month_index,
    cohort_size,
    round(100 * (cohort_size - ifNull(cum_churned, 0)) / cohort_size, 1) AS retained_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        cohort_month,
        month_index,
        sum(joined) OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_month) AS cohort_size,
        sum(churned) OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_month ORDER BY month_index ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_churned
    FROM (
        SELECT
            properties.cohort_month AS cohort_month,
            dateDiff('month', toDate(concat(properties.cohort_month, '-01')), toStartOfMonth(timestamp)) AS month_index,
            sumIf(toInt(properties.customers), properties.movement_type IN ('new', 'reactivation')) AS joined,
            sumIf(toInt(properties.customers), properties.movement_type = 'churn') AS churned
        FROM events
        WHERE event = 'fin:ledger_movement'
          AND timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(now()) - INTERVAL 12 MONTH
          AND timestamp < toStartOfMonth(now())
          AND properties.cohort_month >= formatDateTime(toStartOfMonth(now()) - INTERVAL 12 MONTH, '%Y-%m')
        GROUP BY cohort_month, month_index
    )
)
ORDER BY cohort_month, month_index

items.name: fin_cac_by_channel
items.description: HogFlix Finance: acquisition spend joined to new subscribers and new MRR per channel and closed month. CAC = spend / new subscribers. Payback months = spend / new MRR.
items.sql:
SELECT
    toString(m) AS month,
    channel,
    round(spend) AS spend,
    new_customers,
    round(new_mrr) AS new_mrr,
    round(spend / nullIf(new_customers, 0), 2) AS cac,
    round(spend / nullIf(new_mrr, 0), 1) AS payback_months
FROM (
    -- two sources, one pass: the spend feed and the billing ledger
    SELECT
        toStartOfMonth(timestamp) AS m,
        properties.channel AS channel,
        sumIf(toFloat(properties.amount), event = 'fin:acquisition_spend') AS spend,
        sumIf(toInt(properties.customers), event = 'fin:ledger_movement' AND properties.movement_type = 'new') AS new_customers,
        sumIf(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta), event = 'fin:ledger_movement' AND properties.movement_type = 'new') AS new_mrr
    FROM events
    WHERE event IN ('fin:acquisition_spend', 'fin:ledger_movement')
      AND timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(now()) - INTERVAL 18 MONTH
      AND timestamp < toStartOfMonth(now())
    GROUP BY m, channel
)
WHERE spend > 0
ORDER BY m, channel

items.name: fin_investor_quarterly
items.description: HogFlix Finance: quarterly investor roll-up from the same ledger. Ending ARR, net new ARR, subscribers added and lost, ending subscribers.
items.sql:
SELECT
    concat(toString(toYear(q)), ' Q', toString(toQuarter(q))) AS quarter,
    round(12 * sum(mrr_delta) OVER (ORDER BY q ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS ending_arr,
    round(12 * net_new_mrr) AS net_new_arr,
    new_customers,
    churned_customers,
    sum(customers_delta) OVER (ORDER BY q ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ending_customers
FROM (
    SELECT
        toStartOfQuarter(timestamp) AS q,
        sum(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta)) AS mrr_delta,
        sumIf(toFloat(properties.mrr_delta), properties.movement_type != 'opening') AS net_new_mrr,
        sum(toInt(properties.customers_delta)) AS customers_delta,
        sumIf(toInt(properties.customers), properties.movement_type = 'new') AS new_customers,
        sumIf(toInt(properties.customers), properties.movement_type = 'churn') AS churned_customers
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'fin:ledger_movement'
      AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2024-09-01 00:00:00')
    GROUP BY q
)
ORDER BY q

items.name: fin_payment_failures_weekly
items.description: HogFlix Finance: real product telemetry, not seeded. Checkout payment errors on the Ultimate plan per week (attempts and distinct users), last 12 weeks.
items.sql:
SELECT
    toString(toStartOfWeek(timestamp, 1)) AS week,
    count() AS failed_attempts,
    uniq(person_id) AS users_affected
FROM events
WHERE event = 'pricing:ultimate_payment_error'
  AND timestamp >= toStartOfWeek(now(), 1) - INTERVAL 12 WEEK
GROUP BY week
ORDER BY week
